title: Paul's strange word prepares the argument
english: In many letters Paul places an unusual word that prepares for the argument he is about to introduce. Here too, since he was about to make an appeal on behalf of Onesimus, he shows the credibility of the appeal by his own worth—and his worth is his imprisonment.
